briefdescription.para: Contiguous coefficient storage of a hyper-dual number.

detaileddescription.para:
order
order of the hyper-dual number
x
hyper-dual number
pointer to the 2^order coefficients of x
The coefficients are stored level by level: the first half holds the hyper-dual number of order - 1 that is the value node of the outermost level, the second half the one that is its derivative node. Hence the primal value is at index 0 and the first derivative along level k at index 2^(order - k). This layout is what the order-shifting functions in MarmotAutomaticDifferentiation.h rely on.

briefdescription.para: Compute the gradient of a tensor-to-scalar function where the with dual numbers of arbitrary order.

parameterdescription.para: current order of the dual numers in the tensor
function mapping a tensor to a scalar
input tensor at which the gradient is evaluated

if true and T is a square rank-2 tensor, T (and thus the resulting gradient) is assumed to be symmetric, e.g. the right Cauchy-Green tensor. Only the dim*(dim+1)/2 upper-triangle entries of T are seeded, and the result is mirrored to the lower triangle, instead of all dim^2 entries a ~1.5x reduction in function evaluations for dim=3; the fraction of evaluations needed, (dim+1)/(2*dim), approaches but never reaches 1/2 as dim grows, so this never fully halves the evaluation count. Ignored for tensors that are not square rank-2.

simplesect.para: pair of function value and gradient of f with respect to T, same shape as T
